Our story

Loyal to the
good times

A dog doesn't plan the perfect day. It finds one: a walk on a crisp morning, a spot by the fire, the people it loves within arm's reach. That's the whole idea behind Golden Days, and it's where Bodhi comes in.

We started Golden Days in Massachusetts to make the kind of drink we wanted to share with friends: real fruit juice, a clean splash of vodka, no bubbles, nothing artificial. Good for a summer dock day, and just as good for game night in January.
